```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python time_adjuster.py <input_csv>")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    input_path = sys.argv[1]
    df = pd.read_csv(input_path)
    
    def subtract_four_hours(time_str):
        if pd.isna(time_str):
            return time_str
        time_str = str(time_str).strip()
        try:
            t = datetime.strptime(time_str, "%H:%M:%S")
        except ValueError:
            t = datetime.strptime(time_str, "%H:%M")
        new_t = t - timedelta(hours=4)
        return new_t.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    
    df[' Clock-out'] = df[' Clock-out'].apply(subtract_four_hours)
    df.to_excel('/workspace/adjusted-april-attendance.xlsx', index=False)
    print("Saved /workspace/adjusted-april-attendance.xlsx")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
